note: probe_recall = point-of-need retrievability: share of durable, still-authoritative ground-truth facts present in the method's FINAL store, matched on exact entity tokens (key/port number) within the same category. Probes are queries at the point of need, NOT conversation turns: they are never appended to the replay stream, so turn-window baselines cannot be credited merely because the probe message sits in their window, and template re-use cannot fake a hit (key_19 does not count as recalling key_25). store_recall/durable_recall = store-level retention of ground-truth facts (E2, loose matching). injected_tokens = mean active-context tokens per conversation turn (word count). budget_stressed flags cells where the raw conversation actually exceeded the budget. NOTE: memgpt_style and vanilla_rag are UNBOUNDED stores — their store_tokens far exceed the cell budget, so their high probe recall is buying recall by ignoring the constraint; compare recall per store token, not recall alone.
